name: __MOD_NAME__ Synthesis Briefing
description: Two-phase ALP v1 starter loop: concurrent FIFO pre-flight ledger read followed by a 200-turn ReAct synthesis that saves a verified briefing back into the module database.

inputs.name: objective
inputs.label: Briefing Focus / Question
inputs.placeholder: What should the agent analyze or synthesize from your entries?

phases.name: Phase 1: Parallel FIFO Ledger Snapshot
phases.description: Reads recent entries from the local SQLite database over POSIX FIFO IPC before LLM Turn 1.

phases.name: Phase 2: ReAct Synthesis & Ledger Persistence
phases.prompt_template:
Execute the __MOD_NAME__ Synthesis Briefing workflow.

OBJECTIVE:
{{params.objective}}

FIFO PRE-FLIGHT LEDGER ENTRIES (already fetched in Phase 1):
{{phase.preflight_ledger.entries}}

EXECUTION STEPS:
1. Review the existing ledger entries above and gather any additional context needed.
2. Save a clear, structured briefing into the module's SQLite ledger via `__MOD_PREFIX___save_entry` (with `category="briefing"`).
3. Write structured JSON to `{{result_path}}` via `file_write` with keys: `workflow` ("sample_briefing"), `title`, `summary`, and `recommendations` (array).
4. Call `milestone_complete` and deliver your concise briefing.
